originalTitle: Wall Street ends down as expectations of Hormuz deal fade
summary: STORY: U.S. stocks closed lower on Monday, with the Dow and S&P 500 dipping marginally, and the Nasdaq shedding about a third of a percent. Investors became less confident about a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, which sent U.S. crude prices up about 5% to settle at more than $82 a barrel. Heightened energy prices have spurred inflation worries and led to concerns that central banks would have to raise interest rates. Ryan Isherwood is founder and chief investment officer of Significance Capital Management. "Generally speaking, you know, inflationary signs are a reason for investors to take a little bit of a pause — just, you know, take inventory of where things came from. And we think that's just causing, you know, a little bit of normal digestion, if you will, from the recent strong rally." :: Intel Also weighing on the market were shares of Intel, which fell about 4% after the chipmaker said it was planning to raise $15 billion through a share sale. :: Nvidia And shares of Nvidia dropped roughly 3%. A person familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday that a group of financial firms, including Apollo Global and Blackstone, is working with Nvidia to put together a $500 billion funding package for AI infrastructure development. And shares of Rocket Lab, down more than 3% at the close, fell further in extended trading after the aerospace company forecast third-quarter gross margin below Wall Street expectations, as sales of lower-margin satellite platforms are set to make up a larger share of its business.

chineseTitle: 随着霍尔木兹协议的预期消退，华尔街收跌
chineseSummary: 故事：美国股市周一收低，道琼斯指数和标准普尔 500 指数小幅下跌，纳斯达克指数下跌约三分之一。投资者对重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的协议信心减弱，该协议导致美国原油价格上涨约 5%，收于每桶 82 美元以上。能源价格上涨引发了通胀担忧，并导致人们担心央行将不得不加息。 Ryan Isherwood 是 Significance Capital Management 的创始人兼首席投资官。 “一般来说，通胀迹象是投资者稍稍停顿的一个原因——你知道，盘点一下事情的来源。我们认为，如果你愿意的话，这只是对最近的强劲反弹进行了一些正常的消化。” :: 英特尔 英特尔股价也给市场带来压力，该芯片制造商表示计划通过出售股票筹集 150 亿美元资金，该公司股价下跌约 4%。 :: Nvidia Nvidia 的股价下跌了约 3%。一位知情人士周一告诉路透社，包括 Apollo Global 和 Blackstone 在内的一批金融公司正在与 Nvidia 合作，为人工智能基础设施开发提供 5000 亿美元的融资方案。 Rocket Lab 的股价收盘下跌超过 3%，在这家航空航天公司预测第三季度毛利率低于华尔街预期后，该公司股价在盘后交易中进一步下跌，因为利润率较低的卫星平台的销售将在其业务中占据更大的份额。
